notes.title: Patchnotes v1.0 --- Out of EA --- New Game
notes.content:
[h2]Out of EA[/h2]
Hey people,
Defend Them is now out of EA and has achievements.
One year of EA and 89 sold games (most for less than a dollar), it´s not really much, but it was my first game, so it would be okay and maybe the most didn´t bought it yet, because of EA.

The [b]patchnotes[/b] are not very long, I have only changed the level-loadscreen from "press tab" to "hold tab" (it´s more clear) and added steam achievements.
There are also points now available, to show in screenshots and compare with friends, maybe I want add later the official steam-ladders support, but currently I have no idea, how and it was not my most important steam feature which was needed ^^

Say me what you think about this.



[h2]New Game[/h2]
There is now also a new game available to wishlist, called Biomes: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550150/Biomes_Survival_Era/

I have started it when I was disappointed with the sales of my first game.

It is a survival with more realistic graphics, I were working on at the last 8 months.
It want be a mix of 2 successful survivals, ARK (the dinosaur game) and 7 Days to Die (the zombie game).
But the first version would only bring basic survival mechanics, maybe a little bit more, let´s see how much I can do in my spare time.

There are more genres planned to mix, but currently I don´t want to announce them.


It was always my dream to develop a survival game, I have started some years ago, another survival, but then I realized, that I had not enough experience with programming, so I canceled it and started later, Defend Them, after learning more stuff...


I would love to see as many of you to wishlist it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550150/Biomes_Survival_Era/]here[/url] and also join my [url=https://discord.com/invite/A6X7qCH]discord server[/url] and subscribe my [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQGHDc4vIsruYuMG5aMJzyQ]youtube channel[/url].


Have a nice day
Thomas from Butter Fly Games

notes.title: Update v0.85 - Winter Sale
notes.content:
[h1]Winter Sale [/h1]
The game was not selling so good as I hoped (15 copies in 10 months), so I have decided to bring it more to people by starting a 90% discount sale.


[h1]Patchnotes v0.85[/h1]
Added functionality to be able to equip all towers of all character classes:
[list]
[*] On easy you have a chance of 90% to get your own characters towers and each 5% for a tower of another character class
[*] On medium you have a chance of 66% to get your own characters towers and each 17% for a tower of another character class
[*] On hard there´s a 33% chance for all tower classes to spawn
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed overlapping scrollbars in inventory and character creation
[*] Fixed duping bug when finished map and you are dropping items from inventory (storage)
[*] Fixed bug, where no wood is spawning
[*] Fixed wrong informations in help menu
[*] Fixed resources spawning under ground
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes v0.8
notes.content:
Welcome to the new version v0.8, which makes the game more easy to understand where enemies are coming from and some UI changes.


[h2]Bad News[/h2]
Hey guys,
I have bad news, the game was sold only 14 times in 6 months, that´s why I was waiting so long to bring another update out...
The game want get changed a little bit, some stuff want get removed and planned stuff want never come into the game.
In next months I want add some achievements to the game, but then it´s finished and no more updates are planned.

[h2]Good News[/h2]
I have started another project some months ago, which I think, I want bring on steam too (it´s no more only a test-project)^^
The new project is a top-down-survival with more realistic graphics, more informations about it can be found in next months / years on [url=https://www.instagram.com/butter_fly_games/]instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/B_F_Games]twitter[/url]


[b]Let me know what you are thinking about the current state of this game and my future plans.
[/b]

Have a nice day
Thomas

notes.title: New Character Class - Performance Improvements - Reduced price by 50%
notes.content:
Today the new monk character arrives in Defend Them ! with new fist weapons and aura towers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146593/195e22cad21dd9ca7a20dae10e2879335b8ed276.png[/img]

Yesterday the price of the game was reduced by 50%, because it was too expensive...
Some people said before it released on steam, 10$ would be fine, but I think now it´s too expensive for an early access title from a developer no one has ever heared about^^
I hope there want be now more people who are buying the game and helping me to fix bugs and help me to improve the playing experience.

You are welcome to join the discord: [url=https://discord.gg/TwJDAb3]https://discord.gg/TwJDAb3[/url]

notes.title: Patchnotes v0.4 - New Map - New features
notes.content:
Hey guys,
I was a bit lazy last month, Christmas and stuff ... you know ^^

But I'm on schedule, actually everything is already in the game I wanted to be in the game on release at February 20, 2020.

Only 1.5 months till release, yay!


[h2]New Map - Jungle Airfield[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146593/51c798160b7010ac2e20be85ad7116594159ae92.png[/img]

The new map is a small isle with tropic feeling, enemies are currently:
[list]
[*] Penguin
[*] Tapir
[*] Cassowary
[*] Tiger
[/list]

More want come later^^

[h2]Rewards on Map won[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146593/9fa273bbca274b6072d00fe192bf510ba384002d.png[/img]
The objective of the current map shows you directly which rewards you want get if the map was won (fades in at a certain distance)

Currently rewards are:
[list]
[*] Random Equipment Item
[*] Armor Item
[*] Tower Item
[*] Weapon Item
[*] Coins (ingame currency)
[/list]

Rarity of equipment can be up to legendary, from 2 items on legendary rarity to 6 items on common rarity.
Coins are multiplied by enemies level on the current map and a random amount of 5-30.
For each 25% the objectives health got decreased, the rewards are getting lowered (items by rarity and coins by amount).

[h2]Help Menu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146593/65b6a3f471473948777b4f58421e7b96e52fa463.png[/img]

The help menu got 2 new pages, Item Details with comparison to explain all the stuff and a damage types page with all currently added damage types.


[h3]Patchnotes v0.4a[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased time till wave starts by 2x (easy = 90sec -> 180sec)
[*] Fixed bug where next level button is available, even if map was lost
[*] Added new map number 6 jungle airfield
[*] Changed Rubberball Tower to have attack range
[*] Removed Rubber Ball Particles (for performance)
[*] Changed Rubberball Projectile to bounce only 5 times instead of 22 times (performance)
[*] Swords can do now critical hits too
[*] Added new help menu page, damage types
[*] Fixed bug where enemy is not displaying animation if attacking game object
[*] Added functionality to spawn bonuses when game won
[*] Increased Base Projectile Speed from 3 to 4m/s
[*] Changed "round" in HUD to wave
[*] Changed Enemy Spawn System to allow spawning on only 1 spawnpoint, depending on wave (first wave 1 spawnpoint, third wave all spawnpoints)
[*] Enemies spawn now on all active spawnpoints at the same time
[*] Added new help menu page .... Item Details
[*] Fixed bug with remaining enemies in hud is showing before wave started
[/list]


[h3]Patchnotes v0.4b[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made some changes to the new map, because enemies were sometimes stucking
[*] Changed values of the new enemies, because their sight-range was too high
[/list]

The textures are delayed back into the future, it´s too much work for now, there are more important stuff I need to add^^
